name: SCOTT Addict 40
why_interesting: A CNY 14,549 official-store Shimano 105 Di2 carbon build with an exact size-M listing weight around 8.5 kg and a 38 mm manufacturer maximum.
missing: Final checkout total, current mainland stock and domestic warranty handling
Independent exact-build complete-bike weight with pedals and measurement method
Frame-only weight and independent measured aerodynamic or stiffness data

observed_price.price_basis: Iceberg Green, 24-speed Shimano 105 Di2, size M official flagship-store complete bike
observed_price.conditions: Free SF Express shipping and 48-hour dispatch were displayed; checkout was not submitted

facts.complete_weight_basis: Exact China listing graphic states approximately 8.5 kg in size M; the current global official page lists 8.7 kg, and neither source states pedals or weighing method
facts.frame: SCOTT Addict HMF carbon road frame and carbon fork
facts.frame_material: SCOTT HMF carbon; exact fiber supplier, grade mix and lay-up are not published
facts.frame_construction: Endurance-road carbon chassis with internal cable routing and 34C stock tires
facts.stiffness_evidence: SCOTT claims 25% more vertical compliance than the Addict RC; this is a manufacturer comparison without a public test protocol, not an independent stiffness result
facts.tire_clearance_basis: Current manufacturer maximum for the Addict road family
facts.sizes: Size M selected; complete global size range is published on the official page

source_note: The exact official-store option supplies the CNY 14,549 price and approximately 8.5 kg size-M claim. The current manufacturer page supplies the 38 mm maximum, HMF construction and global 8.7 kg reference. The row uses the selected China build rather than mixing those two weight claims.
